description: This file defines the MetadataHeaderKey interface which is used to handle metadata header keys in the Ditto project, including parsing, creation, and comparison of header keys based on JSON paths.

classes.name: MetadataHeaderKey
classes.description: Interface representing a key for a Ditto metadata header, capable of parsing, creation, comparison, and path retrieval, with knowledge about applicability to JSON leaves.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method to parse a CharSequence into a MetadataHeaderKey, delegating to the factory.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method to create a MetadataHeaderKey from a JsonPointer, delegating to the factory.

methods.name: appliesToAllLeaves
methods.description: Indicates whether the key applies to all JSON leaves affected by a modifying command.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path of the key, adjusted based on whether it applies to all leaves.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key as it would appear in DittoHeaders.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this key with another based on their paths, considering wildcards.
